description: This Java class 'ServiceMcaUtil' provides utilities for managing Service MCA (Mail Content Access?) definitions in the Apache Ofbiz framework. It includes methods for loading configuration from XML resources, caching MCA rules, and evaluating these rules for email messaging within the service layer.

classes.name: ServiceMcaUtil
classes.description: A utility class for managing Service MCA configurations and rule evaluations related to email messaging in the Ofbiz framework.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Clears the current MCA cache and reloads the configuration from resource files.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Reads and loads MCA configuration definitions from service resource info across components.

methods.name: addMcaDefinitions
methods.description: Parses MCA definitions from an XML resource and populates the cache.

methods.name: getServiceMcaRules
methods.description: Returns the collection of loaded Service MCA rules, reloading configs if necessary.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates all the MCA rules for a given email message, dispatcher, and user login context.
